title: Wrapper reports SPAWNED for a spawn that refused
definitionOfDone: A refused spawn is reported as a refusal, not as SPAWNED: a test drives the wrapper with a request the spawner refuses and asserts the returned report carries the refusal outcome and its exact stable reason code, distinguishable by the caller from a real spawn.
A successful spawn still reports SPAWNED with its existing shape, and every current agent-wrapper test stays green and unmodified - this changes only the refused path.

No rejection is swallowed silently: the blanket `.catch(() => undefined)` no longer discards a coded refusal. Any rejection the wrapper still absorbs by design is one it has explicitly classified, and a test names which.
The in-flight bookkeeping stays correct on the refused path: `active` must not retain an entry for a workItemId whose agent never started, asserted directly rather than inferred.

A mutation drill proves the coverage is load-bearing: restoring the unconditional `outcome: "SPAWNED"` turns a NAMED test red on the refusal assertion, and the drill is restored byte-exact and verified by hash.
Fresh pnpm --filter @moe/daemon typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/daemon test exits 0, each leg's exit code read separately.
taskRails: This is a fail-open on the orchestration path. The wrapper must never report SPAWNED for a spawn that did not start; when in doubt about a rejection's meaning, report it rather than absorbing it.

Assert the reason code and the layer, not merely that the outcome differed from SPAWNED. The refusal already carries SPAWN_ARGUMENT_UNQUOTABLE at the spawner; the test must pin what the WRAPPER reports.

Do not re-fix the spawner. task-89071eb1 already landed validate-before-mint and the coded refusal; re-implementing either would be a silent duplicate colliding with landed work in this shared worktree.

A blanket catch on a path that can carry an authority refusal is the anti-pattern being corrected. Do not replace it with a broader catch or a log-and-continue - the refusal must reach the caller's report.

Re-measure agent-wrapper.ts:74 and :226-231 on current bytes before editing; this file moved once already today when the spawner was extracted. Preserve foreign work and commit only explicit owned paths.
